{{Quote|Lieutenant Gregg, you're with me.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness 5">[[Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness 5|''Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Gregg''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. He acted as [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] right-hand man during the early [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Gregg, along with the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]],<ref name="kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Darth Vader vs. Prince Xizor|link=soteKxizor-vader.asp}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], was stationed aboard an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prine]]. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader was tracking [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fugitive [[Dass Jennir]], and a [[Dezono Qua's starship|starship]] matching Jennir's was transmitting a signal from the planet's surface. After reporting that a [[Falco Sang's starship|ship]] involved in a recent break-in at [[Imperial Prison ISO-L8]] was also detected, Gregg joined Vader and the two departed to the planet's surface. There, they captured the prison's intruder, [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Falco Sang]].

During the construction of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] in the aftermath of the [[Ghost Prison incident|Gentis coup]], Gregg attempted to get Vader to listen to a plan of his, to which Vader had him walk with him to see Falco Sang's training. The lieutenant, after giving his report on the progress of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary']]<nowiki/>s training, was then ordered to replace the droid's weaponry with live ammunition and supply orders to wound Sang only, and told him that he'll personally visit the training facility to give Sang more motivation.

The next day, upon the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] arrival, they acknowledged each others presence and proceeded to enter the facility. Gregg then smirked as he witnessed Vader telekinetically lifting an irate and disabled Sang and throwing him against a wall after Sang accused Vader of trying to have him killed. After the [[Tenacious (Venator-class)|''Tenacious'']] disobeyed prior orders and left for [[Arkinnea]], Gregg attempted to report this suspicious action to Vader, though Vader rebuked him, as it didn't supply any apparent, immediate relation to [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunting]].

Gregg, after one of Sang's escape attempts, had the containment facility redesigned to have its doors voice-coded and dead-locked, so that in the event Sang tried to kill him, he won't be able to escape the prison. He then tried to request that Sang try to work with Vader regarding "[getting] Dass Jennir's head," and inferred that Sang try to impress Vader by attacking him. He then revealed that they had delivered Sang's ship to the facility, and witnessed Sang's attempt to fight Vader to impress him. Later, while working late, Lieutenant Gregg was contacted by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself. Glad that Gregg was still at his station, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] told the lieutenant to supply vital information regarding Jennir's likely location, although he also swore to him, like before, not to reveal that he and Palpatine spoke. He then rushed to Vader's location only to stumble on Vader just getting out of his Qaddrath and informed him of Jennir's location at the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] world of [[Kestavel]]. Before he could finish, Lord Vader ordered him to have [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gillehspy]] prepare the [[Hound (Star Destroyer)|''Hound'']] to depart within the hour. Gregg complied with the order, but nonetheless was shocked that Vader planned on taking a ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer over to the planet. He later accompanied Vader to Kestavel, where the latter attempted to attack [[The Lucky Twi'lek]] hotel. However, the mission met complications upon learning that the hotel released engine fuel over the bridge, although Gregg pointed his blaster to his fellow officer's head and told him to not aid Vader, as the latter ordered that none were to interfere in his mission, not even to aid him. He then believed Vader to have been killed when he saw an immense blaze at the area via his [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]].

==Personality and traits==
Gregg was a competent Imperial officer who did his job well. His competence in the search for Dass Jennir quickly catching the notice of Darth Vader who eventually made him his aide-de-camp. Gregg was diligent and committed to his tasks which often caused him to work late into the night despite his exhaustion. Gregg was also ruthless when dealing with enemies and prisoners, displaying a minor sadistic side in regards to the training of Falco Sang.

Despite his loyalty to Darth Vader, Gregg knew better than to disobey the few in authority higher than Vader, particularly the Emperor. When Palpatine came upon Gregg working late at night and questioned him why, Gregg revealed that Vader was having him keep watch for Jedi activity including information on the whereabouts of Dass Jennir, Palpatine allowed him to continue but ordered Gregg not to say a word on their conversation to Vader which Gregg wisely obeyed. Later that same month, Palpatine informed Gregg on Jennir's location which Gregg quickly informed Vader though he withheld from Vader who had given him the information just as Palpatine had ordered him.
